reject.rationale: The observation that a target-specific MUST lives inside a target-agnostic section heading is architecturally accurate but the finding itself acknowledges 'the editorial note scope disclaimer is sufficient' for this fold. Refactoring section topology is out of scope for a single-requirement editorial-patch fold; the existing editorial note provides adequate defensive fencing. No action needed in any release track.

ship_prose:
All four panels converge on ship_with_followups at a unanimous shocked_meter of 8. Zero blocking findings. The fold-now list (F1-F4) is bounded to four surgical prose additions within the req-tg-015 block and Appendix D -- all codify behavior the reference CLI already implements (printable_ascii_text sanitization, _MAX_DROPPED_FIELDS_SHOWN >= 1, string-only preservation). The drafter can apply these in one mechanical pass. Statement-count arithmetic must be reconciled after F2 and F4 land (each adds one MUST); the linter should re-verify all four enumeration surfaces.

The defer-v0.1.1 queue (F5-F8) collects SHOULD-level guidance, cosmetic re-sorting, and minor terminology alignment that improve polish but carry no normative risk if deferred. The single defer-v0.2 item (F9: manifest applicability key) is an architectural schema change that would affect every requirement entry and belongs in a coordinated revision cycle, not a single-requirement fold. Recommend fold_and_ship after the drafter lands F1-F4 and the linter confirms count consistency.
